title: Counting to 20
examples: Teacher, what number comes after seventeen?
Can we count these toys together?
If I have ten and add three, what is the number?

explain.say: Let us count some fun objects together now.
If we count three more apples, how many do we have.
The numbers always go up in a straight line.
When we count, we always say the next number.
Look at these toys. We count them one by one.
If you have five balloons and get two more, you have seven.

faq.q: How do I count things that are not in a straight line?
faq.a: You just point to each thing and say the number for each one. You count them one by one.
asks: Do I count things in a group?

faq.q: What comes right after the number nineteen?
faq.a: The number that comes right after nineteen is twenty. It is the next number in the order.
asks: What is the next number after nineteen?

faq.q: If I count up to ten, and then count some more, how do I know the total?
faq.a: You can count the first group, and then count the second group to find the total number.
asks: How do I find the total number?
What do I do when I count in parts?

faq.q: Do I have to count everything in order?
faq.a: Yes, counting always follows a set order. You must say the numbers one after the other.
asks: Is there a special way to count?

faq.q: What if I count objects that are big and small?
faq.a: The size of the object does not change how you count it. You still count each object as one.
asks: Does size matter when I count?
Can I count big and small things together?

facts: Counting helps us know how many things there are.
When we count, we say the numbers in a specific order.
To find 'one more', we add the numbers together.
The numbers go up from one to twenty.

quiz.say: If there are three red balls and two blue balls, how many balls are there in total?
quiz.why: You count the red balls and then count the blue balls to find the total.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you added the number of colors instead of the balls.
wrong.1: This is wrong because you only counted the first group of balls.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you only counted the second group of balls.

quiz.say: What number comes immediately after the number fifteen?
quiz.why: Number order means you say the next number right after the one you just said.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you said the same number again.
wrong.1: This is wrong because you went backwards instead of forwards.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you skipped too many numbers.

quiz.say: If you start at the number twelve and count three more, what number do you reach?
quiz.why: You count three times starting from twelve: thirteen, fourteen, fifteen.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you put the numbers next to each other.
wrong.1: This is wrong because you went backwards instead of forwards.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you only counted two numbers.
